notes: pivot is the sprite origin as fractions of the frame (x right, y down): [0.5, 1.0] = bottom centre for ground props, [0.5, 0.5] = centre for pickups, [0.5, 0.0] = top centre for hanging props. 'normal' is the matching normal map (same frame layout, OpenGL convention: +X right, +Y up, flat = 128,128,255) for Phaser's Light2D pipeline.

coin.description: Gold coin with a raised beast emblem and reeded edge, spinning about its vertical axis; 12 frames over 180 degrees, loops.

gem.description: Floating faceted soul gem, glowing teal/violet; 12 frames over a quarter turn, loops.

potion_red.description: Health potion flask (red) with meniscus, bubbles and glass highlights.

potion_green.description: Stamina potion flask (green) with meniscus, bubbles and glass highlights.

chest.description: Iron-bound, studded treasure chest with padlock: frame 0 closed, frame 1 open with inner glow.

shrine.description: Checkpoint shrine / obelisk with carved runes: frame 0 unlit, frame 1 runes lit.

gravestone1.description: Rounded gravestone with carved cross and chipped shoulder.

gravestone2.description: Stone cross on a plinth, chipped arm.

torch.description: Wall-mounted iron torch bracket with sooted plate, no flame (flame animated in-game). Wall is behind.

pillar.description: Broken fluted gothic pillar with carved arcading and rubble.

cage.description: Hanging rusted gibbet cage with a shackled skeleton and chains; pivot at the chain top.

brazier.description: Standing iron brazier bowl on a clawed tripod, coals but no flame (flame animated in-game).

banner.description: Hanging tattered crimson banner on a crossbar with a faded beast emblem; pivot at the chain top.
